post.description: Lane W3a (+W3b rule). The human decision; also the registrar's FrontDesk handoff decision. Idempotency-Key required. PROPOSED or REJECTED may move to LINKED or REJECTED (a second review supersedes the first, so the demo can reject and then approve; history keeps both). LINKED only accepts the same-state APPROVE, which returns 200 with the current decision and no new version; any other request on a non-pending state is 409 DECISION_NOT_PENDING.
